scope: Marsh/STH/CAS, GSU/Mugar/Redstone/Pappas and their Charles River frontage; not a completed reconstruction of the whole Charles River Campus

riverfront.basis: Existing MassGIS/MassDOT road axes and widths, MassDEP hydrographic south-bank vertices, and separately authored pedestrian connections
riverfront.limitations: Hydrography is generalized 1:25,000 mapping. Bridge switchbacks, clear heights and walking-path offsets are interpreted geometry, not as-built surveys.

limitations: The source is a 2013 bare-earth survey, not a 2026 site survey.
Building ground-floor levels are inferred from sampled entrance approaches, not architectural as-built elevations.
Runtime interpolation does not resolve individual stair treads, curbs, retaining walls or bridge decks; these require separate geometry.
Outside the core, existing building-base interpolation and the Mass Pike cut remain in use.
Added basement/plinth walls close the gap below rigid buildings; their finishes and openings are approximate.

verificationPolicy: Route and collision checks verify playability only. Architectural footprint comparisons, official plan references and source elevation spot checks are separate evidence for fidelity.

deliveryVerification.build: npm run build:cloudflare passed, including TypeScript and the 25 MiB per-file asset limit
deliveryVerification.browserWalk: MIT bridge approach, Bay State bridge, riverside walk, Silber bridge, Beach-to-Marsh and Questrom walking/stamp/reload assertions passed in the full run. Its final settings-close locator was obsolete because quality selection closes the panel automatically; the corrected remaining quality/map/capture flow passed in --capture-only mode. The full walk log remains in output/questrom-modeling/report.json and the passing tail in output/questrom-modeling/final/report.json.
deliveryVerification.mobileLimit: Mobile browser checks use touch Chromium emulation, not a physical iPhone/Safari crash test.
